ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RM4.5,
Residential Multi-Unit Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 5-F in the area
bound by:

a line 27 feet north of and parallel to West Concord Place; North Burling Street; West
Concord Place; and, the alley next west of and parallel to North Burling Street

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Brian Hopkins !
Alderman, 2" Ward

Common Address:
1616 North Burling Street
